mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_evaluation (question, expected_answer, actual_answer, mode, response_time, tool_count, retrieval_score, eval_score, eval_result, create_time) VALUES (#{question}, #{expectedAnswer}, #{actualAnswer}, #{mode}, #{responseTime}, #{toolCount}, #{retrievalScore}, #{evalScore}, #{evalResult}, sysdate())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_evaluation ORDER BY create_time DESC
